departments.name: Physical Welfare
match: PHYSICAL WELFARE–PHYSICAL EDUCATION AND HEALTH EDUCATION

requirements.name: English
requirements.description: Eight semesters of English, one each semester. Semester electives count as English in senior year and as electives before it.

requirements.name: Mathematics
requirements.description: Six semesters of math, including Algebra 1 and at least one course with geometry content.

source.quote: To graduate, students must earn six semesters of mathematics credit, including Algebra 1 and at least one course with geometry content.

requirements.name: Biological Science
requirements.description: Two semesters of a biological science.

source.quote: Students must complete two semesters of a biological science and two semesters of a physical science in order to graduate.

requirements.name: Physical Science
requirements.description: Two semesters of a physical science.

source.quote: Students must complete two semesters of a biological science and two semesters of a physical science in order to graduate.

requirements.name: U.S. History
requirements.description: Two semesters of U.S. History or AP U.S. History.

source.quote: two semesters/credits of U.S. History (or AP U.S. History)

requirements.name: World History and Geography
requirements.description: Two semesters of World History and Geography.

source.quote: two semesters/credits of World History and Geography

requirements.name: Government
requirements.description: One semester of Government or AP United States Government and Politics.

source.quote: one semester/credit of Government (or AP United States Government and Politics)

requirements.name: Economics or Personal Finance
requirements.description: One semester of Economics, AP Macroeconomics, AP Microeconomics or Personal Finance.

source.quote: This requirement can be fulfilled by one of the following courses: Economics, AP Macroeconomics, AP Microeconomics or Personal Finance.

requirements.name: Health
requirements.description: One semester of Health Education, including Adult CPR.

source.quote: One semester/credit of Health Education is required for graduation, including participation in a unit on Adult CPR.

requirements.name: Driver Education
requirements.description: One semester of Driver Education (or a commercial school certificate or an Illinois license issued before 18).

requirements.name: Required Electives
requirements.description: Two semesters from Applied Arts, Fine Arts, Multilingual Learning, or Computer Science, Engineering and Technology.

source.quote: At least two elective semester credits must come from any of the following divisions: Applied Arts, Fine Arts, Multilingual Learning and/or Computer Science, Engineering and Technology.

requirements.name: Additional Credits and P.E.
requirements.description: Seventeen more semesters of any courses, P.E. included.

policies.label: Stevenson requires P.E. every semester unless Health, Driver Education, Dance or a waiver takes its place
